mentions.name: Sundown
mentions.description: A shared calendar PWA for couples that aims to provide a distraction-free scheduling experience. Built with Django, HTMX, and SQLite, hosted on a Hetzner VPS.
mentions.audience: couples looking to coordinate their schedules together
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a shared calendar for couples. I attempt to build a distraction-free experience inside the app and to keep it as a PWA.

https://joinsundown.app/
mentions.author: avramdames
